qec_code_subspace_rows.code_subspace_object: Route-local code, code subspace, subsystem code, operator-algebra code, erasure-correcting sector, benchmark code, or public-record code surrogate invoked by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
qec_code_subspace_rows.denominator_rule: Declare the logical Hilbert space or target operator algebra, physical carrier, code subspace and total code/reference dimension, sector center, noncommuting factor blocks, noise/erasure model, one fixed correctable region and common CPTP decoder, subsystem/edge convention, factor spectral floor, and worst-sector instrument error. For approximate OAQEC, evaluate the complementary-channel commutant defect in diamond/cb norm with an arbitrary reference; do not substitute an unassisted state error without its dimension-aware lift. Require cross-sector coherence only when full-Hilbert rather than direct-sum algebra recovery is declared.
qec_code_subspace_rows.residual_gap: A direct-sum algebra can be exactly recoverable while licensed off-diagonal sector coherence is dephased. The stronger failure is now reference-stable: unassisted state off-diagonal error can vanish as 1/d_code while the complementary diamond defect remains order one. Hidden sector/frame information, destructive routing, rare bad sectors, factor-block modular transport, and absence of one common decoder remain independent debts.
qec_code_subspace_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer holographic completeness, public-record closure, logical identity, or ToE identification from code-subspace or erasure-correction language alone.
